name: Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981
description: Israel's foundational privacy statute, enacted by the Knesset. Amendment No. 13 (passed August 5, 2024, effective August 14, 2025) is the largest overhaul since 1981, adding DPO requirements, database-registration streamlining, and GDPR-aligned enforcement powers.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Government of Israel (gov.il) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Government of Israel (gov.il).
